rows.en: Both organizations play a critical role in shaping international legal frameworks for intellectual property rights.

clarification.en: WIPO focuses on the administration of IP treaties and global registration systems, whereas WTO TRIPS focuses on the enforcement of IP standards within the global trading system.

relationship.en: Strong IP protection facilitated by WIPO frameworks encourages R&D, which drives long-term economic productivity.
